eb2e6a1cd4091356.zh: 哈佛医学院沃伦实验楼的地下二层是一处恒温恒湿的避风港：常年二十摄氏度，湿度控制在百分之四十五左右，以维持精密仪器与部分试剂的稳定性。Kirin用挂在脖子上的感应卡刷开门禁，空气里弥漫着熟悉的异丙醇与高压灭菌锅残留的闷涩气味。实验台被安置在最内侧的凹陷阴影里，紧挨着一台老旧的梯度PCR仪，风扇的低鸣声日夜不绝。
eb2e6a1cd4091356.en: The second basement floor of the Warren Experimental Building at Harvard Medical School is a constant temperature and humidity haven: 20 degrees Celsius all year round, and the humidity is controlled at about 45% to maintain the stability of precision instruments and some reagents. Kirin opens the door with an induction brush that hangs around her neck, and the familiar smell of isopropanol and autoclave remains in the air.
